_comment: Card and page descriptions written for the Orchard directory, used instead of a worker's own GitHub description when that one is too long, truncated, or reads like implementation notes. Keys are slugs (repo name without vgi-). One sentence, no trailing period, about what you get rather than how it works. Everything not listed here goes through cleanBlurb() in index.ts.
azure-cost: Azure cost and usage — actual and amortised spend by scope, date and dimension
azure-defender: Microsoft Defender and Sentinel security incidents and alerts
azure-directory: Microsoft Entra ID users, groups and devices
azure-files: OneDrive and SharePoint files and list items from Microsoft 365
azure-governance: Entra governance posture — conditional access policies, role assignments and expiring credentials
azure-loganalytics: Run KQL queries against Azure Monitor Log Analytics workspaces
azure-resourcegraph: Inventory your whole Azure estate with Resource Graph KQL
azure-risk: Entra ID Protection risk — risky users, risk detections and risky service principals
azure-signins: Microsoft Entra sign-in and directory audit logs
bluesky: Bluesky posts, threads, profiles, followers, feeds, trends and the live Jetstream firehose
github: GitHub repositories, issues, pull requests, commits, releases, contributors and Actions runs
hackernews: Hacker News front page, stories, comment threads and users
kalshi: Kalshi prediction markets — markets, order books, candlesticks, trades and events
llm: Call LLMs from SQL — Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter or local Ollama — plus local embeddings
fixedformat: Read and write fixed-width and mainframe files, including COBOL copybooks and EBCDIC
ortools: Optimisation with Google OR-Tools — routing, scheduling, assignment, flows and bin-packing
symbols: Symbolicate native stack addresses to function, file and line from DWARF and PDB debug info
google: Google Sheets, Drive, Calendar and YouTube, plus any Google API through Discovery
mlb: MLB standings, schedules, box scores and player statistics
open-meteo: Open-Meteo weather — forecasts, history, air quality, marine, flood and climate data
typesafe: Ask TypeSafe System One questions — choice, noul and score — row by row
scikit-bio: scikit-bio — sequence analysis, alignment, community diversity, ordination and phylogenetics
scikit-learn: scikit-learn — datasets, metrics, transforms and a train/predict model registry
yfinance: Yahoo Finance price history, quotes and symbol search
